explication: Quasar is a Vue framework and project toolchain for creating and running applications across web, server-rendered, static, mobile, desktop, and browser-extension targets. A typical developer starts with project scaffolding, configures an app, then runs development or production commands; the app tooling selects a platform mode to serve or build. The repository also provides the UI runtime, icon/font extras, icon asset generation, and an MCP server for framework documentation and API access. The README documents these capabilities; only selected storage, positioning, and MCP source excerpts were available, so uncertain internal calls are omitted.
